name: Maggran's Reserve Letter
summary: At Sun Rock Retreat, Maggran Earthbinder sends orders to relieve a guard at the Great Lift. The letter promises Grish Longrunner leave to visit his family.

sections.title: A Sentry Relieved
sections.body: Maggran Earthbinder sends orders from Sun Rock Retreat to the Great Lift. Grish Longrunner, a Horde sentry at the post, is to be relieved by a replacement warrior. The Great Lift's wooden winches stand far to the south, where Grish has kept watch. With the new warrior taking his place, he can leave his post and return home to visit his family.

faq.q: What is the purpose of Maggran's Reserve Letter?
faq.answer: Maggran Earthbinder's orders relieve Grish Longrunner from his post at the Great Lift in the southern Barrens, so he can return home and visit his family.
Maggran Earthbinder wrote the letter. He is an elder at Sun Rock Retreat in the Stonetalon Mountains.

faq.q: Who is meant to receive it?
faq.answer: The letter is addressed to Grish Longrunner, a Horde guard stationed at the top of the Great Lift, which connects the southern Barrens to Thousand Needles.
Carry the letter south across the Barrens to the edge of the Thousand Needles canyon, where the Great Lift stands.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you can see its effort to care for scattered forces by sending fresh reserves to remote outposts across Kalimdor.
